description: Build system used on the origin/ROS2 branch (with colcon)
Hesai CSV (Channel,Elevation,Azimuth) per unit, ending in a SHA-256 line; supplies each channel's elevation and azimuth offset
Applies a tangent-space increment to a manifold state; boxminus is the inverse difference
Build system used by FAST_LIO main branch; ROS2 replaced it with ament/colcon
Livox per-point packet message (offset_time, line, tag); parsed by Preprocess::avia_handler for Avia/Horizon/Mid-360
offset_R_L_I / offset_T_L_I in the state; seeded from mapping/extrinsic_R,T and optionally refined online when extrinsic_est_en is true
hku-mars LiDAR-inertial odometry (FAST-LIO2 in its current form); the algorithm this repo implements, pinned at commit 7cc4175
Hesai CSV (channel,firetime/us) giving each laser's firing offset; adds to per-point time and to azimuth correction
a*b+c with one rounding; fixtures build with -ffp-contract=off so the compiler adds none, Rust never emits them
FAST-LIO's estimator: IMU-driven prediction, then repeated point-to-plane updates until the state increment converges (esekfom.hpp update_iterated_dyn_share_modified)
Git submodule (include/ikd-Tree) holding the local map; supports point insert with voxel downsample, box delete, kNN search, and lazy rebuild on a background pthread
Header-only C++ toolkit in include/IKFoM_toolkit that implements the IESKF generically over manifold-valued states
Accelerometer and gyroscope; the JT128's built-in one reports at 200 Hz inside the LiDAR packets, in g and deg/s
Hash-of-voxels map from Faster-LIO; an alternative to ikd-Tree, not used because the Rust port follows FAST-LIO exactly
128-channel mini LiDAR (360 x ~187-189 deg, built-in IMU) that the Rust port targets; speaks Hesai UDP protocol v1.4
Pose estimation that fuses LiDAR scans with IMU readings; FAST-LIO is a tightly coupled LIO
First 8 bytes of a lio --rays file; then per frame u32 count, f64 begin, f64 end, u8 kind and 40-byte ray records
Template/macro layer under IKFoM (MTK_BUILD_MANIFOLD) that composes vect, SO3 and S2 into one state type with boxplus/boxminus
The ARM vector instruction set; Eigen's NEON kernels fuse some double-precision multiply-adds
C/C++ pragma-based threading; FAST-LIO uses it for its correspondence loop, enabled by its CMake only on x86 (MP_EN, 3 threads with more than 4 cores)
PCL's point cloud file format; FAST-LIO writes the accumulated map to PCD/scans.pcd when pcd_save_en is set
C++ library FAST-LIO uses for point types and VoxelGrid downsampling; only the fixtures image uses it
Hesai's TCP command channel (SDK default port 9347); 0x05 returns angle calibration, 0xA9 returns firetimes
Rust data-parallelism crate; runs lio-core's correspondence search on all cores, RAYON_NUM_THREADS sets the count
ROS axis convention (X forward, Y left, Z up); Hesai's frame is Y forward, X right
Requires sensor_msgs/Imu in m/s^2 and rad/s; Hesai's ROS driver publishes g and deg/s
Unit-sphere state type with 2 DOF; FAST-LIO stores gravity as S2 so its magnitude stays fixed at 9.81
Here Hesai LiDAR SDK 2.0, the reference the jt128 decoder is checked against
Vector instructions (NEON on ARM, SSE/AVX on x86); Eigen's SIMD reductions fix the summation order the plane fit reproduces
libm call returning sine and cosine of one angle together; GCC and LLVM merge adjacent sin and cos into it, with the same results as separate calls
Unstable radix-based sort PCL 1.12's VoxelGrid uses; leaves the summation order within a voxel unspecified
One pose per line: t x y z qx qy qz qw; the format of lio --path
Packet format shared by Pandar128, OT128 and JT128; byte 4 >= 137 marks JT128
Spacing between adjacent floating-point values; used to size Rust-vs-C++ differences
